_doc: RG CubeXX (Allwinner H700), tested with knulli + MustardOS (either default); ROCKNIX tested on Vol+ of a 3-OS card (default, Vol- and 2-OS cards not yet). Allwinner vendor U-Boot 2018.05: it reads partitions by GPT name (env, boot, boot-resource) and its bootcmd always ends in 'run setargs_mmc boot_normal', so the multi-boot choice is a new boot_normal in the shared env partition. It has the simple command parser (no hush: no if/then/else). Image names, src offsets/sizes (sfdisk -d <image>) and the boot package sector are tied to specific image releases.
name: CubeXX
_key_pins: Vol-, Vol+ (PE2, PE1: bank E = 4 * 32); shown in --plan only, the env reads the PE data register
_uboot_sectors: knulli's raw area: boot0 at sector 512 (the boot ROM's 256K fallback), boot package at 32800; sectors 2-15 hold the GPT entries (gpt_entries), 16+ get boot0
_gpt_entries: after DRAM training the firmware writes boot0 to sector 16 (seen on a CubeXX card: it destroyed a standard GPT's entry array, sectors 2-33, and nothing booted). MustardOS's image uses 8 entries (sectors 2-3); 16 = sectors 2-5 (at most 56 end before sector 16)
_boot: env-h700: the vendor U-Boot from the knulli image, with boot_normal etc. added to knulli's env (copied from env_src)
_env: U-Boot env inside the uboot_os image: [start, size] of its 'env' partition; the env itself is the first env_size bytes (CRC32 + data)
_images: file names in img/; * matches any text (the newest matching file, by modification time, is used); a plain name pins one file
_src: partitions copied from each image, in order: ["pN", start, size, what]: partition N of the image; start/size (sectors) are read from the image's partition table when it is present (a difference is shown as NOTE in --plan) and are only the fallback

knulli: image p3: FAT KNULLI 5G (boot-resource); its ext4 SHARE is replaced
image p1: Android boot image 20M (stock 4.9.170 kernel + ramdisk)
mustardos: image p4: Android boot image 64M (same kernel as knulli's)
rocknix: image p1: FAT ROCKNIX 2G (KERNEL, SYSTEM, device_trees)

_dtb: knulli and MustardOS boot with knulli's U-Boot control dtb (bootm always passes it; plain fdt addr is ignored, tested); MustardOS's branch renames gpio_keys in it with fdt set (muinput needs muOS-Input-Source, tested). rocknix: its dtb on its FAT, fixed (os_opts dtb_fixes) and written raw to dtb_rocknix; its branch switches the control dtb to it with fdt addr -c (untested). fatload/fatwrite mmc 0:N don't work on this U-Boot (tested)
_os_opts: knulli boot_files: checked on KNULLI (kernel and ramdisk are in its Android boot image).

rocknix._aboot: Android boot image built from KERNEL (mainline arm64 Image, text_offset 0: needs a 2MB-aligned load address). max_kernel: the vendor bootm's CONFIG_SYS_BOOTM_LEN (32M); the 20261101 KERNEL is 32135176 bytes
rocknix._dtb_fixes: fix_dtb: memory = /memory if missing; no_map = the vendor BL31 range (knulli's package 'monitor' at 0x48000000, reserved by its dtb's /memreserve/); free_regulator = vdd-dram (DDR3 overlay not applied: boot0 set the voltage); max_size: below the vendor control dtb's size (bootm copies that many bytes)
